title: Make explicit Core harness MCP client close stop stdio children
goal: Ensure an explicit MCP client close releases a stdio child immediately instead of waiting for the client object to be dropped.

results.change: StdioTransport now implements the transport close hook with its existing child-stop path, so McpClient::close immediately kills and reaps the stdio child and remains idempotent.
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib mcp: 23 passed, 0 failed
results.boundary: Core harness MCP stdio lifecycle only; no dependency, Commercial, harvest, release, or credential changes
results.limitation: The process-backed child-reap regression is Unix-only because the current host is Linux; the production close path uses portable std::process APIs.
